source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor will change status when module is removed or inserted
Check SEL will have corresponding logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All STATUS_FAN1~16 should get pass result.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not directly runnable with a single stock high-level command: STATUS_FAN 1~N requires raw/implementation-specific IPMI bytes + exact expected output which the library has not specified; give exact bytes/result to run.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due status-versus-temperature and 1~N-versus-1~16 contradictions.

original_test_intent: Validate fan presence/status and SEL transitions for an intended fan population, but the source disagrees on population and evaluates unrelated thermal thresholds.
original_method: An engineer removes and reinserts a fan module while IPMI records status and SEL.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer performs each physical fan removal/insertion; the agent may collect mapped status and SEL evidence.
required_inputs: Presence/status values and SEL event IDs
Redundancy, thermal limits and service/recovery SOP
safety_requirements: Do not remove a fan without thermal/redundancy margin and an immediate restore path.
Do not infer temperature-threshold criteria for a presence test.
Safety-stop on rising temperature or redundancy loss; no retry.
agent_execution_scope: After source correction, capture per-fan status, RPM, temperature and SEL before/removal/reinsertion.
Do not perform physical service or verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct fan population and criteria; execute service action.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly refuses to guess raw bytes; a documented read path is still needed after correction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use mapped read-only IPMI/Redfish fan status plus independent thermal monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 1~N Items, 1~16 Criterion, physical action, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Align population and status criteria, then service one mapped fan at a time while correlating presence/RPM/SEL/thermal response and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform fan service and redundancy specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes thermal-copy criteria and count ambiguity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents partial population or unrelated temperature evidence from passing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan removal can cause rapid thermal escalation.

project_override_considerations: A project-specific fitted count must be recorded; it cannot silently resolve the Master Source contradiction.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items say STATUS_FAN 1~N, Criterion 5 says STATUS_FAN1~16, while Criteria 1-4 require temperature threshold behavior instead of module presence/status.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The authoritative population and acceptance semantics are contradictory; executing physical removals before correction could test the wrong set and cannot yield a valid verdict.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines exact correction and physical safety boundary.

review_improvement: Separates fan presence/status validation from thermal threshold testing and requires a canonical population.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fan can change presence/status without crossing temperature thresholds, and N cannot be presumed to equal 16; both contradictions affect the core acceptance claim.
